newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore middle distillate stocks at 10-mth high.
newsitem.headline: Singapore middle distillate stocks at 10-mth high.

text.p: Weekly Singapore middle distillate stocks rose to their highest level since November 1995, the latest data from the Trade Development Board (TDB) showed on Thursday.
TDB said middle distillate stocks at 7.913 million barrels in the week ended September 11, up 888,000 barrels from the week earlier.
Middle distillate stocks were last higher in the week ended November 8, 1995 at 8.578 million barrels.
